equity.level_reason: Only age (adults aged ≥60 years) defines the population. Race, SES and other social-position dimensions are not analyzed; frailty and long-term care residence are clinical or risk factors.

level_alternative.reason: Limited trial enrollment of frail, advanced-age and long-term care residents is named as a limitation; if residence is read as a social-position dimension, equity is raised only as a limitation.

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity and SES are not reported; trial enrollment of frail, advanced-age and long-term care residents was limited.

notes: Efficacy and safety are manufacturer-calculated trial results; the primary-endpoint efficacy CIs are 96.95% and 97.5%. The efficacy model is not named, so it is 'other', and 'Fisher' is a false hit (Miller Fisher syndrome). Setting is international trial data, though the title says United States.
view_issues: The Pfizer phase 1/2 trial is described as enrolling participants aged ≥65 years, while the report's population and phase 3 trial are ≥60 years.
